title: Mid-Autumn Approaching: Huili Ancient Town,
description: Huili is an ancient town lying in the far south of Sichuan Province. Founded in 111 BC, its name conveys the meaning "rivers and plains converging". As a key stop on the Southern Silk Road, it earned the title "Gateway Between Sichuan and Yunnan". Huili features a well-preserved Ming Dynasty military guard post, with streets radiating from the Bell and Drum Tower to four gates, part of a checkerboard layout that also comprises 23 lanes.
